Cut from a Japanese cotton moleskin, the fabric has a soft, broken-in handle from the first wear, while nickel-plated denim-style buttons replace the usual horn, a subtle nod to classic Americana and workwear traditions. The silhouette is deliberately boxy and relaxed, borrowing from the straightforward proportions of factory coats and workshop jackets, designed to layer easily and move without fuss.
Three patch pockets at the hip, plus an additional tool pocket on the chest, provide generous storage and nod to traditional atelier and studio garb, while raglan sleeves and an unbleached cotton lining bring a quietly sartorial note.
The result is a working coat in spirit, but one that sits just as comfortably with tailoring as it does with denim.
